summary: HectareHQ rebrand + Start Spray Job workflow frontend-only test. Full flow verified end-to-end: 40/40 assertions passed. Home shows 'HectareHQ' (zero 'AgSpray' occurrences), weather card meta line displays 'Your location · <lat>,<lon> · Updated HH:MM' with a working refresh button. Start Spray Job navigates to /records/new; all 6 form sections render; Open-Meteo weather auto-populates Temp/RH/Delta T/Wind/Direction; Delta T recomputes on manual Temp/RH edit (4.2 -> 8.6 at 25°C/40% RH). Farm chip -> Paddock chip auto-fills area (42ha) and crop; Tank mix chip adds a product row with default rate/unit and 'Total: N' live-updates when area changes (63.00 L at 42ha -> 150.00 L at 100ha). Cancel returns Home without persisting; Save Draft persists as status='draft' and does NOT appear in Recent Records (2 seeded) or Records tab (2). Start Job captures fresh weather/GPS, creates active job, navigates to /active-job/[id]; LIVE elapsed timer renders in HH:MM:SS and visibly increments (00:00:39 -> 00:00:45 after 6s). Home + Spray tab both show 'Resume Active Spray Job' while active. Finish flow opens Finish details section with finish-weather prefilled from Open-Meteo; Save Completed Record navigates to /records/[id] and record appears in Records tab (3) + Recent Records on Home (3). Cancel Job removes the active job cleanly (no orphan; Records tab still 3).
action_items: No action required. All 15 test cases in the review request pass. Main agent can self-verify or ship.
critical_code_review_comments: records/new.tsx buildJob() always returns a job (never null) but calls signature returns SprayJob|null and callers guard with 'if (!job) return' — dead-code guard, minor cleanup opportunity.

records/new.tsx startJob() sets `setStarting(true)` but only calls `setStarting(false)` after weather capture and buildJob; if buildJob returned null the loading state would stay true. Currently unreachable but a defensive `finally` would be safer.

active-job/[id].tsx startMs derives from job.date + job.start_time (HH:MM local). Since date is ISO date only and start_time has no timezone, timer relies on the device local TZ matching the date. Works in practice but slightly fragile across midnight or TZ changes — consider persisting an ISO created_at as the timer anchor (already stored) rather than reconstructing from date+time.

weather.ts falls back to Wagga Wagga (-35.117, 147.356) on permission denial. In browser preview geolocation is denied, so all users see that fixed location — acceptable for demo but the meta line still says 'Your location' which could be misleading. Non-blocking.
No deprecated Expo packages detected (no expo-av / expo-barcode-scanner / expo-background-fetch). Uses expo-location, expo-router, expo-web-browser — all current.
All interactive elements have testID; StyleSheet.create used; text wrapped in <Text>; TouchableOpacity/Pressable used correctly.
seed_data_creation: None — used existing seed (2 completed jobs baseline). Created 1 draft, 1 completed, and 1 cancelled active during the run; final Records tab shows 3.
context_for_next_testing_agent: AsyncStorage-only. To reset: localStorage.clear() in web preview.
